description: Crystal versus AlphaFold conformational comparison of the LMTK3 active site, and a map of catalytic elements across the three LMTK3 numbering systems
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

# ---- load crystal (renumbered to Q96Q04) and AlphaFold model ----
cr=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6SEQ.pdb",timeout=120).text
X=defaultdict(dict)
for l in cr.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[21]=="A" and l[16] in (" ","A"):
        X[int(l[22:26])-29][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
af=requests.get(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q96Q04",timeout=90).json()[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
F=defaultdict(dict); plddt={}
for l in af.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        rn=int(l[22:26]); F[rn][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        plddt[rn]=float(l[60:66])
CACHE={}
def ref(p,c,k3,e,f):
    if p not in CACHE:
        t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=120).text
        A=defaultdict(dict)
        for l in t.split("\n"):
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[16] in (" ","A"):
                A[(l[21],int(l[22:26]))][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        CACHE[p]=A
    A=CACHE[p]; g=lambda r,a:A.get((c,r),{}).get(a); z=g(f,'CZ')
    return (float(np.linalg.norm(g(e+4,'CA')-z)), float(np.linalg.norm(g(k3,'CA')-z)),
            min(float(np.linalg.norm(g(e,a)-z*0+g(e,a))) if False else float(np.linalg.norm(g(e,a)-g(k3,'NZ'))) for a in ('OE1','OE2')))
def loc(M):
    g=lambda r,a: M.get(r,{}).get(a); z=g(285,'CZ')
    return (float(np.linalg.norm(g(185,'CA')-z)), float(np.linalg.norm(g(164,'CA')-z)),
            min(float(np.linalg.norm(g(181,a)-g(164,'NZ'))) for a in ('OE1','OE2')))

pts=[("LMTK3 crystal 6SEQ",*loc(X),"tab:red","D"),
     ("LMTK3 AlphaFold AF-Q96Q04-F1",*loc(F),"tab:red","^"),
     ("PKA 1ATP (active)",*ref("1ATP","E",72,91,185),"tab:green","o"),
     ("SRC 1Y57 (active)",*ref("1Y57","A",295,310,405),"tab:green","o"),
     ("INSR 1IR3 (active)",*ref("1IR3","A",1030,1047,1151),"tab:green","o"),
     ("SRC 2SRC (autoinhib)",*ref("2SRC","A",295,310,405),"tab:orange","s"),
     ("SRC 1FMK (autoinhib)",*ref("1FMK","A",295,310,405),"tab:orange","s"),
     ("ABL1 1IEP (imatinib)",*ref("1IEP","A",271,286,382),"tab:purple","v")]
T=pd.DataFrame([dict(model=p[0],D1=round(p[1],2),D2=round(p[2],2),saltbridge=round(p[3],2)) for p in pts])
print(T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv("lmtk3_conformation_panel.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,5))

ax=axes[0]
for lbl,d1,d2,sb,c,mk in pts:
    ax.scatter(d1,d2,s=150 if "LMTK3" in lbl else 85,c=c,marker=mk,edgecolor="k",zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(lbl,(d1,d2),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(7,5),fontsize=7.5)
ax.axvline(11,ls="--",c="grey"); ax.axhline(11,ls="--",c="grey")
ax.text(4.0,17.0,"DFG-in quadrant",fontsize=9,color="tab:green")
ax.text(11.4,6.3,"DFG-out quadrant",fontsize=9,color="tab:purple")
ax.set_xlabel(r"D1: $\alpha$C-Glu+4 C$\alpha$ to DFG aromatic C$\zeta$ ($\AA$)")
ax.set_ylabel(r"D2: $\beta$3-Lys C$\alpha$ to DFG aromatic C$\zeta$ ($\AA$)")
ax.set_title("A  Both LMTK3 models place the DYG tyrosine\nin the DFG-out quadrant",fontsize=10); ax.grid(alpha=.3)

ax=axes[1]
names=[p[0] for p in pts]; sbv=[p[3] for p in pts]; cols=[p[4] for p in pts]
ax.barh(range(len(names))[::-1],sbv,color=cols)
ax.axvline(3.5,ls="--",c="k"); ax.text(3.65,6.6,"ion pair formed\n(< 3.5 $\\AA$)",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(sbv): ax.text(v+0.2,len(names)-1-i,f"{v:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel(r"$\beta$3-Lys NZ to $\alpha$C-Glu carboxylate ($\AA$)")
ax.set_title("B  The K164-E181 ion pair is broken in the crystal\nbut formed in the AlphaFold model",fontsize=10); ax.grid(axis="x",alpha=.3)

ax=axes[2]
feat=[("Gly-rich loop G140-G145",140),("beta3 Lys K164",164),("alphaC Glu E181",181),
      ("gatekeeper M210",210),("catalytic Asp D266",266),("cat-loop Asn N271",271),
      ("Mg-binding Asp D284",284),("DYG Tyr Y285",285),("APE Glu E313",313)]
ax.plot([133,411],[0,0],lw=7,color="#dddddd",solid_capstyle="butt")
for nm,u in feat:
    ax.plot([u,u],[-0.1,0.1],lw=2.5,color="#c44e52")
    ax.annotate(f"{nm}\nQ96Q04 {u} | 6SEQ {u+29} | X1 {u+26}",(u,0.13),rotation=90,fontsize=7,ha="center",va="bottom")
    ax.plot(u,-0.35,marker="o",ms=4,color="#4c72b0")
    ax.annotate(f"{plddt[u]:.0f}",(u,-0.47),fontsize=7,ha="center",color="#4c72b0")
ax.text(272,-0.63,"AlphaFold pLDDT",fontsize=8,color="#4c72b0",ha="center")
ax.set_xlim(125,420); ax.set_ylim(-0.75,1.25); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue position in UniProt Q96Q04 (kinase domain 133-411)")
ax.set_title("C  Catalytic elements and the three numbering systems\nin use for LMTK3",fontsize=10)
for sp in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
